word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Nostr Relay Tags

conceptHeader.description: A nostr-relay-tag is an assertion that a specific nostr relay belongs to a tag category. Each element links a relay event ID (kind 39999 in the nostr-relay concept) to a tag event ID (kind 39999 in the tag concept). Authors publish these assertions to express their opinion about which categories a relay fits into; aggregated across a web of trust, these assertions build reputation and power trust-weighted relay recommendations.
